messages:
incident-bot: Pager — High GPU pool utilization detected in gcp-us-west1 (pool: inference-prod-1). Autoscaler attempted 3 scale-ups but instance attach failed: QuotaExceeded. Backlog ~1.9k requests. Possible customer latency/errors. Severity: potential customer impact.
oncall_nick: Ack — I'm on it. Switching to SRE rotation and paging infra.
sre_alex: Looking at autoscaler logs: repeated attach denies with GCP error: \"QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You have no available GPUs in this project/region\". Also 429s from compute API.
infra_maya: Confirmed with quick check. Running gcloud to enumerate GPU quotas.
```
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-prod --format=\"json(quotas)\"
```
infra_maya: Output shows NVIDIA_TESLA_T4: limit=200, usage=200 -> 0 available.
ops_tariq: Can we failover to a different region or use spare pool in us-central1?
oncall_nick: Immediate mitigation plan (short term):
- Divert non-critical traffic to gcp-us-central1 spare pool (20% initially)
- Enable fallback to quantized smaller model variants for public/low-tier requests
- Route enterprise customers to dedicated reserved capacity (if available)
- Open quota/increase request with GCP (longer lead time)
infra_maya: I can patch routing rule now. Will also reduce default batch size for hosted-api to lower slot contention.
product_jan: Noted customer impact: two customers show elevated error rates in dashboards. Starting comms draft.
custome r-success-amy: I'll prepare customer notices and flag the two affected accounts for priority support.
sre_alex: Quick commands I'm running to verify failover path and backlog:
```
# check queue length
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=router -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'
redis-cli LLEN inference:request_queue
```
sre_alex: Queue length confirms ~1900 pending. Latency SLOs breached for some routes.
ops_tariq: Patching traffic routing to divert 20% -> us-central1 now. Patch applied: rolling restart of routing pods.
infra_maya: Also toggled model fallback: enabled quantized-8bit variants for public endpoints and lowered max_batch_size=8.
oncall_nick: Can someone confirm the attach error is quota and not a regional outage?
sre_alex: Confirmed via GCP support console — no regional outage, purely project quota exhaust. GCP support ticket opened (case 12345678).
incident-bot: Severity escalated to SEV2 (potential customer impact).
product_jan: Drafted customer message: short note about degraded latency in us-west1, mitigation steps, ETA for remediation — please review.
customer-success-amy: Sent to two affected customers with proactive mitigation steps; they acknowledged.
infra_maya: Temporary additional mitigation: forced fallback to CPU for batch jobs tagged background=true to free GPUs for low-latency requests.
sre_alex: Monitoring backlog after routing change — backlog dropping slowly (1900 -> 1200 in 12m). Error-rate for hosted-api reduced from 8% -> 3%.
oncall_nick: Good. Next steps: 1) keep routing diversion until quota increase or more capacity comes online; 2) follow up with GCP quota approval; 3) postmortem action items (autoscaler to detect QUOTA_EXCEEDED and auto-fallback).
ops_tariq: I pushed a temporary autoscaler policy tweak: when attach returns QUOTA_EXCEEDED, do not spin additional retries for 15m and trigger cross-region fallback.
infra_maya: Patching infra now — adding guard to autoscaler. Code snippet:
```
if attach_error == 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED':
  mark_region_unavailable(region)
  route_to_alternate_region(region_alts)
```
ops_tariq: Deployed patch to canary autoscaler pool. Observability shows no new attach retries for now.
incident-bot: Note added: oncall_nick -> handoff to slo-night oncall in 30m.
oncall_nick: Handing to @sre_monica in 30. @sre_monica please confirm that cross-region routing remains stable and that backlog continues to drain.
sre_monica: Ack. I'll join the bridge in 10 and monitor metrics.
product_jan: Post-incident action: submit quota increase with GCP for us-west1, add autoscaler feature to detect quota denies and failover automatically, improve runbook for quota saturation.
customer-success-amy: Final update to customers: performance partially restored, mitigation active, will send follow-ups after full resolution.
incident-bot: Incident update logged. Severity remains SEV2 until quota increases or backlog clears.
oncall_nick: Wrapping up primary handoff. Thanks team — keep pager on.
